name: LM393 Comparator
rules: The output lets go when IN+ is above IN−, and pulls to ground when it isn't.
It can only pull down. A pull-up resistor makes the HIGH.
Two in one package: tie the unused half off (IN+ to ground, IN− to VCC) so it can't flap around.
flavor: It answers exactly one question, very fast: is this bigger than that?
